title: ficus malayana
intro: Ficus malayana, commonly known as the Malay banyan, is a species of fig tree native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Ficus malayana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties. Additionally, Ficus malayana has been traditionally used to treat fever, respiratory problems, and wounds, making it a valuable plant in folk medicine.
